complete_examples.text: A Green’s function-based hybrid dynamic model with high efficiency is established to achieve the long-distance analysis of the vehicle-track-subgrade interaction system with a wide range of subgrade settlement.

The novelty of this work lies on the analysis of VTS dynamic interaction subject to a long-distance subgrade settlement through a Green’s function-based hybrid dynamic model, and by introducing the time-frequency combined technique, the low-frequency components of vehicle vibrations excited by the settlement are extracted and associated to the settlement characteristics.
